title: ShareIt
tagline: This dApp is used for storing files and also can be used for sharing files.
description: A decentralized version of Google Drive for the Web3 ecosystem having similar features but with a few key differences: Decentralization: The platform would be decentralized, meaning that data would be stored on a network of nodes rather than on a single centralized server, making it more secure and resilient against data breaches and outages. Interoperability with other Web3 applications: The platform could be designed to interact with other decentralized applications in the Web3 ecosystem, allowing for seamless data exchange and integration. Privacy: Privacy would be a key focus, with users retaining control over their own data and being able to choose who has access to it.
how_its_made: The project includes multiple technologies like a smart contract in Solidity which is deployed on Polygon testnet, the graph for fetching, and nextJS for frontend. We have used web3 storage for storing files. In this project, the graph is used to reduce the fetch time. Filecoin is benefited to storing files.
